name: rolling-code-audit
description: Standing, never-finished codebase review: score areas by staleness from a standing GitHub issue, review only the stalest per run, file findings as issues, and rotate; a second command lets a newer model re-derive the plan itself.

safety.githubWrites: issue creation, edits, and comments are previewed and require user confirmation
safety.standingIssue: never closed; a missing standing issue stops the run instead of creating one
safety.scope: the audit observes and files issues only; it never fixes code
safety.commandBudget: the replan command must keep the system at exactly two commands
